workspaceUi.customizeDescription: Tell the agent what to change in {scope}. Skill and Agent edits save directly; protected workspace/config changes keep their existing review flow.
workspaceUi.customizePlaceholder: For example: add a read-only Bybit BTC chart to the home dashboard and create a Market Watch page in the menu.
workspaceUi.presetWidgetHint: Ticker, chart, metric, table, shortcut, or approved Skill panel
workspaceUi.presetWidgetPrompt: Add a read-only Bybit BTC/USDT market ticker widget to this surface. Use a stable widget id, show the source and refresh interval, and preserve every existing widget.
workspaceUi.presetPageHint: Add a declarative page and place it in the operator menu
workspaceUi.presetPagePrompt: Create a read-only Market Watch page and add it to the primary menu. Include a BTC/USDT chart and a short data-source note, using stable page and widget ids.
workspaceUi.presetSkillHint: Create or revise a reusable SKILL.md-backed capability
workspaceUi.presetSkillPrompt: Create or update a reusable research Skill that produces a concise market brief with cited evidence. Inspect existing Skills first, then save the Skill directly.
workspaceUi.presetAgentHint: Create or update a persistent role, model, tools, and Skill allowlist
workspaceUi.presetAgentPrompt: Create or update a persistent market-research Agent role. Reuse existing Skills where possible, define a narrow tool/Skill allowlist, and show the exact role configuration before saving it.
workspaceUi.presetConfigHint: Safely change non-protected runtime or workspace defaults
workspaceUi.presetConfigPrompt: Inspect the current workspace configuration and propose a safe non-trading setting change. Explain the exact target and diff, and keep protected risk, secret, approval, and live-trading settings unchanged.
workspaceUi.agentPreamble: You are customizing Nerya through its audited conversational tools.
workspaceUi.agentRules: Choose the authoritative route for the request. Dashboard, widget, page, or menu changes: call workspace_ui_inspect first, then workspace_ui_propose with small operations; prefer stable ids plus upsert_widget/upsert_page, preserve existing content, and never rewrite YAML or edit React/TSX. Skill changes: inspect the current Skill, edit the Workspace Skill directly, and save immediately without creating a proposal. Persistent Agent roles: inspect with role_list/role_get as needed, then save directly with role_save. Other non-protected configuration: use evolve_core_config_patch and name the exact target and diff. Never enable live trading or change protected risk, secrets, signer/approval policy.
workspaceUi.approvalHint: Skill and Agent edits are saved directly. Workspace UI and protected configuration changes may still use their existing review flow.

runtimeFlags.title: Runtime capability gates
runtimeFlags.description: Master switches for whole feature areas such as the evidence vault and the review queue. Turn one off and that area disappears from Nerya until you switch it back on.
runtimeFlags.configDescription: These switches write to the current workspace runtime config without changing code defaults. Use them to enable, pause, or fence off optional runtime surfaces per project.

capabilityCatalog.title: Capability Catalog
capabilityCatalog.summary: Controls the runtime catalog that shows which system capabilities, entrypoints, statuses, and readiness signals are currently available.
capabilityCatalog.scope: Capability catalog API, home runtime health summary, and settings entrypoints that rely on the capability list.

dataSourceSync.title: Data Source Sync Status
dataSourceSync.summary: Controls the status view for market, news, on-chain, and other data sources so operators can see freshness and sync delays.

toolResultCompaction.title: Tool Result Compaction
toolResultCompaction.summary: Controls whether large tool outputs are compacted before entering the model context, preserving key evidence while reducing context load.
toolResultCompaction.scope: Agent tool results, LLM context injection, and summary handling for long outputs.

evidenceVault.title: Trading Evidence Vault
evidenceVault.summary: Controls the evidence archive for trading research, strategy verification, and runtime decisions so prior reasoning can be reviewed later.
evidenceVault.scope: Evidence read/write APIs, trading evidence cards, and validation or review artifacts.

promptGuardReview.title: Prompt Safety Review Queue
promptGuardReview.summary: Controls whether prompts or actions blocked by the safety guard enter a human review queue for higher-risk requests.
promptGuardReview.scope: Security review APIs, inbox pending items, and prompt-guard human verdict workflow.

operatorProfile.title: Operator Preference Profile
operatorProfile.summary: Controls reading and updating long-term preferences, working style, and operating habits so the Agent can adapt to the current operator.
operatorProfile.scope: Memory profile APIs, settings profile data, and context building that depends on the operator profile.

e2eArtifactCapture.title: End-to-End Verification Capture
e2eArtifactCapture.summary: Controls whether validation logs, screenshots, request/response traces, and run artifacts are archived for demos, regression checks, and audits.
e2eArtifactCapture.scope: E2E evidence APIs, run artifact storage, and validation materials shown to reviewers or operators.
